sources.name: CRO CORE — Companies Registration Office company search
sources.verdict: National commercial register front-end (companies, business names, LPs). Free basic search; documents paid. Not fetch-tested this session but confirmed as the canonical register via cro.ie.

sources.name: CRO Open Data Portal
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (fetched). CKAN portal with Company Records and Financial Statements datasets, bulk + API, CC-BY 4.0, updated daily. This is the primary machine route into the Irish register — implements EU Open Data Directive high-value datasets.

sources.name: CRO Open Services (CORE REST API)
sources.verdict: RESTful company/submission API documented on cro.ie (Access to CRO Data page, verified via search). services.cro.ie itself returns 403 to generic fetchers — keyed/registered access.

sources.name: data.gov.ie — Company Records dataset
sources.verdict: National open-data catalog entry for the CRO company dataset; confirmed via search. Useful as a stable catalog pointer alongside opendata.cro.ie.

sources.name: RBO — Central Register of Beneficial Ownership
sources.verdict: Exists, but general public access is restricted post-CJEU (legitimate-interest regime). Documented only — do NOT plan ingestion; constitution forbids assuming open UBO data.

sources.name: Central Bank of Ireland Registers
sources.category: financial regulator registers (banks, MiFID firms, AIFMs, ManCos, credit servicers, VASPs)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED robots.txt: search pages, fund/firm data pages AND the Downloads page are disallowed for all bots including ClaudeBot. HARD RULE: document only, never harvest. Route around via ESMA/EBA registers below.

sources.name: ESMA Registers portal (entities under AIFMD/UCITS/MiFID incl. all Irish AIFMs and ManCos)
sources.category: EU regulator register — fund managers & investment firms
sources.verdict: ESMA's registers are the sanctioned machine route to the Irish AIFM/UCITS/firm population that CBI robots-blocks. Downloadable datasets; not fetch-tested this session.

sources.name: ESMA MiCA interim register (CASPs, incl. Irish authorisations e.g. Coinbase Europe, Kraken Ireland)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search: ESMA publishes the MiCA CASP register as CSV files updated roughly weekly until integrated into ESMA IT systems mid-2026. Preferred over the robots-blocked CBI VASP pages.

sources.name: EBA credit institutions register (EUCLID)
sources.verdict: EBA's payments/credit-institution register has documented API access; covers Irish licensees. Not fetch-tested this session — verify endpoint shape before build.

sources.name: Pensions Authority — PRSA Providers & Products Register
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search: register published as PDF (e.g. /wp-content/uploads/2025/08/...PRSA-Providers-and-Products-Register-August-2025-1.pdf). Occupational scheme data appears in annual reports/statistics rather than a searchable public scheme register.

sources.name: Central Bank of Ireland Open Data Portal
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (fetched). CKAN portal, 39 datasets across financial corporations, markets, credit/banking — includes quarterly Irish-resident investment fund statistics. Statistics, not registers, so not robots-blocked.

sources.name: IAASA — register of statutory auditors/audit firms
sources.verdict: IAASA is the Irish audit authority; publishes the public register of statutory auditors and recognised accountancy bodies. URL real; register route not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: Charities Regulator — public Register of Charities
sources.verdict: Fetch returned 403 to bots this session. Register historically offers a downloadable extract — re-verify with a browser before ingestion planning.

sources.name: Iris Oifigiúil — official gazette
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search: published Tuesdays/Fridays since 1922; PDFs online from 2002 with keyword-searchable archive at /archive/. Carries receiver appointments — key distressed signal.

sources.name: CRO Gazette (weekly company notices: strike-offs, liquidations, name changes)
sources.verdict: CRO publishes a weekly electronic gazette of statutory company notices. Exact landing path not fetch-verified this session — confirm under cro.ie publications.

sources.name: ISI — Insolvency Service of Ireland public registers (bankruptcy, DRN, DSA, PIA, protective certificates)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search: statutory public registers exist but search is by exact first name + surname only — no browse or bulk. Suitable for lookups, not enumeration.

sources.name: ISI — Register of Personal Insolvency Practitioners (PIPs)
sources.verdict: ISI maintains the authorised PIP register (personal insolvency only — Ireland has no licensing register for corporate liquidators). Not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: Courts Service of Ireland — judgments & determinations
sources.verdict: Written judgments of the superior courts published as a browsable index; Commercial Court and examinership/winding-up judgments are rich distressed-credit signals. Not fetch-tested this session.

sources.name: Courts Service Online (CSOL) case search
sources.verdict: Online courts portal; some functions require registration. Not fetch-verified — check terms before any automated use.

sources.name: European e-Justice — Ireland insolvency register interconnection
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search: EU-side documented route into Irish insolvency register data (IRI interconnection). Useful as harmonized fallback.

sources.name: Euronext Dublin — listed equities (Main/ESM/GEM)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search as the live issuer list (~50 equity listings; also large debt/GEM listing venue). live.euronext.com is a JS app; export endpoints exist behind interaction — treat as JS-rendered.

sources.name: Euronext — company news / regulatory announcements (Dublin issuers)
sources.verdict: Issuer RNS-equivalent disclosures for Dublin listings. Same JS platform caveat; not fetch-tested.

sources.name: IVCA — Irish Venture Capital & Private Equity Association member directory
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (fetched): 24 full members listed in plain HTML (Act, Atlantic Bridge, Melior, Molten, SOSV, Waterland...). Sibling pages /about/affiliate-members/ and /about/associate-members/ cover overseas firms and advisors.

sources.name: Irish Funds — member directory
sources.category: funds-industry association (admins, ManCos, depositaries, law firms)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via homepage fetch: members page at /about/members/. The single best map of the Irish fund-servicing ecosystem (category 6 service graph).

sources.name: BPFI — Banking & Payments Federation Ireland members
sources.verdict: Represents banks, fintechs and — via its FIBI/credit-servicing affiliates — the NPL-servicer community. Member list on site; not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: Insurance Ireland — member list
sources.verdict: Industry body for (re)insurers incl. Dublin's cross-border reinsurance hub. Member list published; exact path not fetch-verified.

sources.name: Aircraft Leasing Ireland (Ibec group)
sources.verdict: Ireland hosts ~60% of world aircraft leasing — ALI is the sector body and member map. URL pattern from Ibec site structure; not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: IAIM — Irish Association of Investment Managers
sources.verdict: Buy-side association with member list. Not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: IAPF — Irish Association of Pension Funds
sources.verdict: LP-side association (schemes, trustees, advisors); publishes investment surveys. Not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: ISIF — Ireland Strategic Investment Fund portfolio
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (homepage fetch confirms /portfolio and /news). NTMA-managed sovereign fund; publishes its Irish investment portfolio incl. commitments to domestic PE/VC/credit funds — a public LP-commitment goldmine.

sources.name: NTMA — National Treasury Management Agency
sources.verdict: Parent of ISIF/NAMA(residual)/NewERA; publications and press index. Not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: NAMA — National Asset Management Agency (wind-down)
sources.verdict: CAUTION: RTÉ feed (verified) reports NAMA dissolved in 2026 after 16 years; residual functions revert to NTMA. Historical loan-sale data still valuable; treat as archival source.

sources.name: SBCI — Strategic Banking Corporation of Ireland
sources.verdict: State promotional bank; publishes its on-lending partners (banks + non-bank lenders) — a direct-lender discovery route. Not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: HBFI — Home Building Finance Ireland
sources.verdict: State lender for residential development finance (real-estate debt). Not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: IDA Ireland
sources.verdict: FDI agency; announcements index is a steady signal of inbound investment. Not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: Enterprise Ireland
sources.verdict: One of Europe's most active seed investors by deal count; publishes Seed & Venture Capital scheme reports naming backed funds. Not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: eTenders — Irish public procurement portal
sources.verdict: Central tender/award platform (all awards >€25k must publish). Machine route is the OGP open-data channel below.

sources.name: OGP procurement open data (OCDS)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search: eTenders data published as open data with API (OCDS-registered publication, supplements TED below-threshold). CC licensing — check the non-commercial clause on the OpenTender mirror (opentender.eu/ie is CC BY-NC-SA).

sources.name: EPA — EU ETS Union Registry (Irish national administrator)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search: EPA administers Irish Union Registry accounts and ETS permitting (incl. ETS2 and maritime). Account-holder data itself lives in the EUTL.

sources.name: EUTL — EU Transaction Log (Ireland accounts & installations)
sources.verdict: EU-level public view of Irish ETS account holders, installations, compliance and allocations. Not fetch-tested this session; long-standing stable public resource.

sources.name: SCSI — Society of Chartered Surveyors Ireland (RICS-affiliated) member search
sources.verdict: The Irish RICS-partnered body — find-a-surveyor directory covers accredited valuers (real-assets service graph). Not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: PSRA — Property Services Regulatory Authority licence register
sources.verdict: Site fetched but content truncated; PSRA licenses auctioneers/agents/property managers and publishes the licensee register. Re-verify register download route.

sources.name: Law Society of Ireland — find a solicitor/firm
sources.verdict: Solicitor and firm search (fund-formation and M&A law-firm mapping). lawsociety.ie confirmed live via its Gazette (search hit); search tool not fetch-tested.

sources.name: The Bar of Ireland — Law Library member directory
sources.verdict: Barrister directory incl. insolvency/commercial specialists. Not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: Property Price Register (PSRA)
sources.verdict: All residential sale prices since 2010 as downloadable CSV — core real-assets dataset. Long-established; not fetch-tested this session.

sources.name: Tailte Éireann (Land Registry / Registry of Deeds / Valuation)
sources.verdict: Merged land registration/valuation body; landdirect.ie search is paid per-folio, some open data on valuation. Not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: CRU — Commission for Regulation of Utilities licence registers
sources.verdict: Publishes lists of electricity/gas generation and supply licensees — an entity route into renewables/energy-transition SPVs. Register format is PDF lists; not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: CSO — data.cso.ie (PxStat API)
sources.verdict: Central Statistics Office open API (PxStat/JSON-stat) for macro, property, construction series. Well-known stable API; not fetch-tested this session.

sources.name: RTÉ Business news
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (feed fetched, fresh to Aug 3 2026): banking results, PTSB/Bawag takeover, NAMA dissolution, insolvencies. Best free Irish business wire.

sources.name: The Currency
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (feed fetched): examinerships, NAMA post-mortem, corporate tax, deal analysis. Paywalled articles but feed gives headline+summary — ideal headline+link ingestion under our copyright rule.

sources.name: Silicon Republic
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (feed fetched, current): funding announcements, tech expansion, science. Primary Irish startup-funding signal.

sources.name: TechCentral.ie
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (feed fetched, current): Irish tech/data-centre/infrastructure coverage.

sources.name: TheJournal.ie
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (feed fetched, current). Business coverage folded in after Fora.ie closed; general-news noise ratio is high — filter by keywords.

sources.name: Finance Dublin
sources.category: IFS trade publication (funds, aviation finance, capital markets)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (site fetched; site states RSS at /rss.php). Covers funds monitor, aviation finance, M&A, tax — squarely our beat. Feed URL itself not separately fetched.

sources.name: Irish Times — Business
sources.verdict: Paper of record for Irish business. Legacy cmlink RSS feeds circulate (feedspot) but could not be verified; site blocks bot fetches. Treat as headline-only via licensed/manual routes.

sources.name: Business Post
sources.verdict: /feed/ returns 403 to bots (tested). Strong PE/property/deals coverage, paywalled. No verified feed.

sources.name: Irish Independent — Business
sources.verdict: Mediahuis blocks bot fetches (tested — fetch refused). RSS endpoints not verifiable this session.

sources.name: Irish Examiner — Business
sources.verdict: Two candidate RSS paths tested and 404'd. Business coverage real (Munster corporate base); feed route unresolved.

sources.name: Business Plus
sources.verdict: Fetch refused at network level this session. WordPress site so /feed/ likely exists — unverified; re-test from a browser.

sources.name: Irish Legal News
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (fetched): daily legal news for IE/NI, 12k+ subscribers. No RSS found on page (email-first); /rss and /rss.xml 404. Browsable HTML index.

sources.name: Irish Tech News
sources.verdict: WordPress publication; standard /feed/ assumed but NOT fetch-verified this session — confirm before wiring.

sources.name: Central Bank of Ireland — news & press releases
sources.verdict: Main centralbank.ie site (unlike registers subdomain) serves normal pages per search results. Enforcement actions, fund-sector speeches, statistics releases. Feed existence unverified.

sources.name: Department of Finance — press releases (gov.ie)
sources.verdict: gov.ie publishes departmental press indexes; no RSS on gov.ie. Policy signals: funds-sector review, IREF/s110 tax changes.

sources.name: Houses of the Oireachtas Open Data API
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (fetched): 'Houses of the Oireachtas Open Data APIs' — bills, debates, questions. Machine route for legislative signals affecting alternatives (also serves as gazette-adjacent record).

sources.name: NTMA / ISIF news
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (nav link from isif.ie fetch). Commitment announcements to Irish funds = public LP-commitment signals.

sources.name: IDA Ireland — latest news
sources.verdict: FDI/expansion announcements. Path from site convention; not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: CEA — Corporate Enforcement Authority news
sources.verdict: Successor to ODCE; publishes enforcement outcomes relevant to distressed/insolvency graph. Not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: Wind Energy Ireland — news & members
sources.category: renewables sector body (energy-transition signals + member map)
sources.verdict: Sector association for the largest Irish renewables class; member directory doubles as entity source. Not fetch-verified this session.

sources.name: CIF — Construction Industry Federation news
sources.verdict: Construction sector body; development-pipeline signals. Not fetch-verified this session.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Deep coverage of Ireland as a fund domicile — Irish AIFMs, ICAVs, QIAIFs, fund administrators, plus Irish LPs (ISIF, pension schemes). Strong on fund-level terms and service-provider relationships; weaker on small domestic GPs and portfolio-company granularity.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Central Bank authorisation lists (pre-robots era) and ESMA registers, CRO filings, ISIF published portfolio and annual reports, pension-scheme annual reports, Irish Funds publications, press releases — all reachable directly via ESMA registers, opendata.cro.ie, isif.ie/portfolio, pensionsauthority.ie.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Good Irish PE/VC deal coverage (buyouts, growth, VC rounds) and law-firm/advisor league tables; captures Enterprise Ireland co-investments unevenly.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: CRO filings (share allotments B5s reveal rounds), IVCA quarterly VentureP ulse-style reports, Enterprise Ireland Seed & Venture reports, Euronext Dublin disclosures, Irish Times/Silicon Republic/The Currency press — all public: opendata.cro.ie, ivca.ie, enterprise-ireland.com, live.euronext.com.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Irish startup ecosystem mapping (often in partnership with local ecosystem bodies); strong on rounds/valualready-public signals, thin on credit, real assets and the service graph.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: TechIreland's open startup database, press (Silicon Republic, TechCentral), accelerator/portfolio pages (NDRC, Dogpatch), CRO for incorporation data — direct routes: techireland.org, siliconrepublic.com/feed, opendata.cro.ie.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow Irish startup/funding coverage, self-reported profiles plus press scraping; frequent gaps on Irish-registered holding structures.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Company self-submission, press releases, Silicon Republic and international tech media — the underlying public layer is the same press + CRO incorporations we ingest directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: The dominant Irish company-information provider: full CRO mirror, credit scores, director networks, daily judgments/insolvency alerts. This is the local benchmark for the entities side.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: CRO bulk data and filings, Iris Oifigiúil (receiverships), CRO Gazette (strike-offs/liquidations), court judgments and registered judgments, ISI registers — every one available directly: opendata.cro.ie, irisoifigiuil.ie, courts.ie, gov.ie ISI registers.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Consumer-grade Irish company reports and director searches; lighter than Vision-net but shows what a lean CRO-derived product looks like.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: CRO open data + document images, CRO Gazette notices — direct route: opendata.cro.ie.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Irish-founded KYB provider reselling live registry lookups across 120+ registers incl. CRO; relevant as proof the CRO Open Services API supports commercial real-time products.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: CRO Open Services API directly — the same keyed API route documented at cro.ie/services-and-help/access-to-cro-data/.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Non-profit open database of Irish startups/innovation (companies, funding, female-founder reports). Semi-open — closest local analogue to a public startup graph; partner data source for Dealroom.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Community submissions, press announcements, Enterprise Ireland/IDA announcements — all public; we can ingest the same press layer (Silicon Republic, RTÉ, The Currency feeds verified above).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Not a database but the highest-signal Irish deals/courts/funds journalism; effectively the qualitative competitor for 'what's happening in Irish alternatives'.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Court filings and hearings (Commercial Court), CRO documents, Iris Oifigiúil, interviews — underlying registers all in our catalog; their RSS feed (verified) is itself an ingestible headline signal.

searchedButAbsent: Searched for but absent or unusable: (1) Fora.ie — defunct since 2020, folded into TheJournal.ie (its verified feed is the successor). (2) Any bulk/open download of Central Bank of Ireland registers — the Downloads page exists but robots.txt (fetched and verified) disallows ALL bots incl. ClaudeBot on search, data AND download pages; per hard rule this is documented-only, with ESMA/EBA registers as the machine route. (3) A corporate insolvency-practitioner licensing register — Ireland does not license liquidators/receivers; only ISI's personal-insolvency practitioner (PIP) register exists. (4) A litigation-funding register — third-party funding remains largely prohibited (limited 2023 arbitration carve-out), so no licensee register exists. (5) Public RBO beneficial-ownership access — restricted to legitimate-interest applicants post-CJEU. (6) Working RSS for Irish Times, Business Post, Irish Independent and Irish Examiner — all tested endpoints 403'd or 404'd; legacy feed URLs circulating on aggregators could not be verified. (7) gov.ie RSS — none exists; press indexes are HTML-only. (8) A standalone Irish MiCA register page usable by bots — CBI's version sits on the robots-blocked registers site; ESMA's weekly CSV interim register is the substitute. (9) An open occupational-pension-scheme register from the Pensions Authority — only the PRSA providers PDF and aggregate statistics are published.
